rationale: The most recent 1-minute candle showed a sharp rejection — opening at $53.59, dropping to $53.38, and closing at $53.41 on very high volume (144K vs ~54K prior), indicating aggressive selling pressure right at the VWAP/9-EMA confluence that was the basis for the long entry.
